name: Milagro
description: Long Island Santana tribute band, playing since 2005, that performs Carlos Santana's hits with a six-piece lineup including timbales and congas, blending rock, blues, Latin and jazz. It plays summer town concerts, street festivals, vineyards and dinner shows across Nassau and Suffolk.

dancing.notes: Latin-rock grooves like Smooth and Oye Como Va invite dancing, and a dinner-show listing invited people to listen and dance. Many gigs are outdoor town concerts where most people sit, so expect some freestyle dancing near the stage.

evidence.note: About page: Santana tribute since 2005 with timbales and congas, mixing rock, blues, funk, Latin and jazz.
2026 schedule: town concerts and festivals in Patchogue, Northport, Center Moriches, Lake Grove and more.
Past dinner-show listing at Anthony's Live (Lake Ronkonkoma) inviting guests to listen and dance to Santana hits.
